description: Create a voucher via /Voucher/Factory/saveVoucher. Defaults to status 50 (Entwurf) so nothing is booked without you reviewing it in sevDesk. Set taxRule 5 for Reverse Charge §13b, 1 for normal domestic VAT, 3 for intra-EU. WRITE operation. For anything this wrapper does not cover, use sevdesk_call with operationId 'voucherFactorySaveVoucher'. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

dryRun.description: Show the payload instead of sending it.

extra.description: Additional top-level voucher fields merged into the payload verbatim.

payDate.description: Payment date, dd.mm.yyyy — only with status 1000.

taxRate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 19 or 0.

supplierName.description: Supplier name as it should appear on the voucher.

name: sevdesk_create_voucher
title: Create a voucher
